text:
Carmen: Heads-up — planning final staging->prod cutover for the Acadia private VPC. Target window: Thu 00:30-01:30 UTC. Need owners for network cutover, cert rotation, smoke tests, and rollback. Who can take which?

Raj: I can own the network cutover (BGP peers + route tables) and DNS handoff. Will be on standby 00:15->01:45 UTC.

Olivia: I’ll take cert rotation and client config rollout. I’ll run the cert rotation script and validate listeners.

Lee: I’ll run the smoke suite and perf sanity — latency, p99, QPS, and a quick end-to-end request check. Planning to use a small loadgen job from staging region.

Carmen: Awesome. @sre-oncall can you be rollback owner if anything hits major errors?

sre-oncall: Yep, I’ll own rollback. Rollback plan is documented below — revert node pool to pre-cutover image and reapply the terraform tag. I’ll coordinate with Raj for routing reflip.

Raj: Rollback trigger suggestions: >5% 5m error rate spike OR sustained p99 > 2x baseline OR customer auth failures. If any of these, we abort and run the rollback steps.

Olivia: Smoke check quick commands I’ll use: ```bash
# quick cert / ingress check
./scripts/cert_rotate.sh --env prod --preview
./scripts/ingress_probe.sh --host acadia.example.com
```

Lee: Smoke test checklist (quick):
- basic health endpoints /_health -> 200
- simple chat generation 1 prompt -> <300ms median (for control plane)
- embeddings endpoint sample -> match baseline sims
- DB migration no pending locks
I’ll post a 10-line result summary at +10m after cutover.

Carmen: PR/final infra bits — is PR #4023 merged and applied to the pre-cutover image?

Raj: PR #4023 merged to main, image baked and tagged acadia-precut-202603. Terraform diff reviewed. I’ll run `terraform apply -auto-approve` at T+10 unless we hit veto.

Carmen: Good. Reminder: we’ll do a staggered traffic shift: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m soak at each step. If any smoke checks fail, we step back to previous weight and evaluate.

devops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: Acadia Private VPC cutover (window 2419994321 -> 2419995850). Reminder notifications will be sent at 2h, 30m, and 5m before window.

Lee: Quick note on observability: I’ll have dashboards up for token latency, model load times, and error rate. If dashboards fail to populate within 3 minutes after traffic shift, treat as a red flag.

Olivia: Cert rotation note — client certs for the private nodes are rotated in-place; they should be compatible for 10 minutes. If any client fails, rollback will include restoring previous certs.

sre-oncall: Rollback commands (if needed):
```bash
# revert infra to pre-cutover
git checkout tags/pre-acadia-cutover && terraform apply -var="image=acadia-precut-202602" -auto-approve
# notify network for route flip
/opt/tools/route-flip --target acadia-old
```
I’ll run these and confirm in thread.

Carmen: Can each owner post a single-line START and DONE in thread when they begin/complete their step? Helps tracking.

Raj: START network cutover at T+2m (will post status updates).

Olivia: START cert rotation at T+4m.

Lee: START smoke suite at T+6m. Will paste quick results.

sre-oncall: Standing by. I’ll post ROLLBACK if we need to execute and DONE when complete.

Carmen: Thanks team. I’ll upload the final runbook URL here 30m before window and ping customer success with the maintenance notice. :thumbsup:
